sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM shop.customer
SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM shop.customer WHERE region_code = 'N'
SELECT region_code, count(*) AS customers FROM shop.customer GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY region_code
SELECT count(*) AS transfers FROM shop.transfer WHERE transfer_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND transfer_date < DATE '2024-02-01'
SELECT sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM shop.transfer

SELECT c.region_code, count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers, count(a.account_id) AS accounts FROM shop.customer c JOIN shop.account a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region_code ORDER BY c.region_code
SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM shop.order_header o LEFT JOIN shop.customer c ON c.customer_id = o.legacy_customer_id WHERE o.order_id = 7
SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM shop.order_header o LEFT JOIN shop.customer c ON c.customer_id = o.legacy_customer_id WHERE o.order_id = 8
SELECT count(*) AS order_lines FROM shop.order_line l JOIN shop.order_header o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN shop.customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'W'
SELECT 'ZQXROW' AS tag, count(*) AS suppliers FROM shop.supplier

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id FROM shop.order_line l JOIN shop.order_header o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN shop.customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE l.product_id = 0 AND c.region_code = 'N' ORDER BY c.customer_id
SELECT count(*) AS accounts FROM shop.account
SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_lines, sum(qty) AS total_qty FROM shop.order_line WHERE product_id < 9 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY product_id
SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM shop.order_header
